name: PDF
author: Saeed
description: Read the text of PDF files, search inside them, and look at a page as a picture (catalog pages with tables, curves and drawings) so Saeed can read what text extraction cannot.

tools.name: info
tools.description: Number of pages and document information.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read the text of a PDF, optionally a page range (1-based).

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find a word or phrase in a PDF; returns the pages and the text around each hit.

tools.name: render_page
tools.description: Draw one page as an image and look at it. Use it for tables, performance curves, drawings and scanned pages. scale 1.5 is readable; use 2.5 for small print.
